title: How to Add Your Elevate Pay Card to Google Pay
summary: Add your Elevate Pay Visa Signature virtual card to Google Wallet. Follow the setup steps, tap to pay where supported and fix common payment issues.
body_markdown:
Add your Elevate Pay Visa Signature virtual card to Google Wallet to pay with your Android phone at supported contactless terminals.


## What you need first


-


An Android phone with NFC turned on, for tap to pay in stores.


-


The Google Wallet app, from the Play Store.


-


A screen lock on your phone. Google requires one for contactless payments.


-


An active Elevate Pay Card. Before paying, top up enough to cover your purchase and any fees.


Google Wallet and tap to pay availability can depend on your country and device.


Apple Pay is not available yet. On an iPhone, use your card details to pay online and in apps.


## How to add your card to Google Wallet


1.


In the Elevate Pay app, open your card from the bottom menu, then tap it to see the card details.


2.


Open the Google Wallet app.


3.


Tap **Add to Wallet** .


4.


Choose **Payment card** , then **New credit or debit card** .


5.


Enter your card number, expiry date and CVV from the Elevate Pay app. Use the name and billing address linked to your Elevate Pay account.


6.


Tap Save and continue, read the issuer terms and tap Accept.


7.


Complete the verification steps shown in Google Wallet. If you're asked for a one-time code, enter the code we send you.


8.


Your card appears in Google Wallet after setup. Check that it is ready for contactless payments before you tap to pay.


If the card is saved but setup is incomplete, follow the verification prompt in Google Wallet. For setup help, see[Google's card setup guide](https://support.google.com/wallet/answer/12058983?hl=en) .


## How to pay in stores


1.


Look for the contactless symbol on the payment terminal.


2.


Unlock your phone.


3.


Hold the back of your phone near the terminal.


4.


Wait for the confirmation on your screen.


The payment uses your card balance. Make sure your available balance covers the purchase and any fees before you tap. Top up in the app if needed; top-ups are instant and free.


## How to pay online and in apps


1.


At checkout, choose the **Google Pay** button.


2.


Select your Elevate Pay Card.


3.


Confirm the payment.


Google Pay can share a token with the merchant instead of your actual card number.


## Using Google Pay abroad


Where Google Wallet is supported, you can tap to pay at contactless terminals that accept Visa.


The **1.5% cross-border and cross-currency fee** applies when you pay a merchant outside the US or pay in a currency other than USD, even at a US merchant. For non-USD payments, our card processor sets the exchange rate. We don’t add a markup. See all card fees.


If a terminal abroad offers to charge you in USD, check its exchange rate and any extra charges before accepting. The 1.5% fee still applies when the merchant is outside the US.


## When a Google Pay payment fails


**Not enough on your card:** check the declined payment in your card transactions, then top up enough to cover the purchase and any fees.


If you locked your card, unlock it in the Elevate Pay app before trying again.


**Over your daily limit:** the default is $5,000 across all card payments, including Google Pay. Check Limits in the app. Email us athelp@elevatepay.co to request an increase; approval isn't guaranteed.


**NFC is off or phone is locked:** turn on NFC in your phone settings and unlock your phone before tapping.


Card setup is incomplete: check the verification or setup message in Google Wallet. Confirm that your card details and billing address match your Elevate Pay account.


Starting December 1, 2026, we’ll count only payments declined because your card is locked or your card balance is too low. Earlier declines won’t count. In each calendar month, we’ll email you at 3 counted declines, automatically charge $1.50 to your card balance at 5, and permanently cancel your card at 8. If your card is cancelled, you’ll need to apply for a new one before you can pay again.


If the payment still fails, email us athelp@elevatepay.co with the payment date, amount and merchant name.


Learn how to[top up your card](https://help.elevatepay.co/hc/en-us/articles/53078664510225-How-do-I-top-up-my-card) ,[check your spending limit](https://help.elevatepay.co/hc/en-us/articles/53078836428561-What-is-my-card-spending-limit) , or[lock and unlock your card](https://help.elevatepay.co/hc/en-us/articles/53079000796305-How-do-I-lock-or-unlock-my-card) .


## Frequently asked questions


### Can I use Google Pay at an ATM?


No. The Elevate Pay Card is virtual and does not support ATM withdrawals.


### What if my phone is lost?


Emailhelp@elevatepay.co immediately to report the lost phone. If you can access the Elevate Pay app from another device, lock your card there straight away. Follow[Google's lost-device guidance](https://support.google.com/wallet/answer/7643925?hl=en) to find, lock or erase your phone. Erasing the phone removes its payment information.


### Does locking my card stop Google Pay?


Yes. New Google Pay payments will be declined while your card is locked. If you locked it yourself, you can unlock it in the Elevate Pay app.


### Is Apple Pay available?


Apple Pay is not available yet. You can still use your card details to pay online and in apps on an iPhone.
